structural_repair_finding.note: On 0aec00c0 the structural repair emitted NO PMF and NO candidate id for any prop (100% NULL). Root cause: the StructuralRepairModel column map defaulted to actual_*-prefixed names while the production feature matrix stores realized per-game volumes BARE (oreb/dreb/fga/fg3a/fta), so _has() found no columns and every prop silently abstained. NOTE: the 'structural_target_mean' column (9,896 non-null) is UNRELATED — it is the AST/TOV minutes-offset rebuild target (pmf_utils.apply_minutes_offset_rebuild), not the structural repair candidate.
structural_repair_finding.fix: Added train-time column AUTO-DETECTION (bare vs actual_ aliases) so all three structural props resolve on production column names, plus a pts 3P+non-3P FALLBACK decomposition (uses actual_pts+fg3m+fg3a; no fgm/ftm required). Proven via synthetic build_oof_pmfs --strict-baseline dry-run: structural_active_pmf_json non-null + structural_candidate_id populated for pts/reb/fg3m.
